changelog: FIX: 'Switch to Lite Mode' in Settings now actually works. The toggle was persisting correctly but the live UI never re-read the new value (required a full app kill to see it). Made the mode reactive — flipping the toggle now switches the UI instantly.
FIX (v514): Permanent Fire Stick ANR fix — Moshi JSON adapters now compile-time generated, eliminating the kotlin-reflect global lock that was crashing low-end Fire Sticks ~10 s after home loaded.
FIX (v513): Throttled the license-check poll from every 2 s back to every 30 s — drops UI recomposition pressure 15×.
FIX: Tightened player HTTPS timeouts so playback failures show 'Reconnecting…' inside 10 s instead of a 20-30 s black screen.
FIX: Resolved Google Play Protect 'harmful app' warning during install.
FIX: Player on-screen options menu D-pad selection.
FIX: Discovery hero TMDB backdrop fallback.
FIX: Settings shows $50 CAD / year correctly.
FIX: Parental Controls hide locked categories everywhere.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
